description: OSINT / investigation / ethical-hacking connections for the operator command center. Each server is OPT-IN: the operator supplies credentials and confirms legality/ToS before enabling. 'enabled:false' means scaffolding only.
notes: Authorization gate applies to every active connection — see docs/ETHICS-AND-AUTHORIZATION.md.
Secrets are NEVER stored here; reference env vars (e.g. ${SHODAN_API_KEY}). Keep keys in the NAVIG vault / .env (gitignored).
Passive/open sources are preferred. Active scanners require an in-scope, authorized target.

servers.purpose: Read/write case files, evidence notes, memory, arsenal — sandboxed to the space.
Queryable case database — entities, findings, assets, timeline. Backs the OSINT graph.
Open-source web search for OSINT collection (passive).
Fetch + extract a URL to text/markdown (passive read of public pages).
Headless browser for JS-heavy pages, screenshots, archived snapshots (passive).
Passive DNS, WHOIS, cert-transparency, ASN lookups for infra footprinting.
Internet-exposure data for AUTHORIZED targets (attack-surface mapping).
servers.legality: Use only against assets you are authorized to test; Shodan data is passive but scope still applies.

servers.purpose: Exposure check (which breaches an email appears in) — legitimate sources only.
servers.legality: HIBP only. Do NOT wire raw breach-dump/combolist sources — that crosses legal lines.

servers.purpose: Run vetted recon CLIs against IN-SCOPE targets (subfinder, httpx, naabu, nuclei, amass).
servers.legality: GATED: refuses to run unless an active, authorized engagement in engagements.json covers the target.

servers.purpose: Version case files and evidence notes; diff timelines.
Code/secret/identity OSINT across repos and commits (public + your orgs).
Run the space's python skills (memory mutations).
